title: AEGIS futures product catalog, version 1
description: Exchange, product and instrument metadata (AEGIS-011): venue, product root, tick size, lot size, multiplier, currency, timezone and session-template reference. Validated by python/futures/instruments.py, which is the only reader; there is no second copy of these rules to fall out of step with it.

schema_version.description: Mandatory and enumerated, like configs/schemas/config.v1.json's config_version: a catalog written against a future schema is rejected rather than silently reinterpreted.

product_root.description: Product/root symbol shared by every contract in the chain.

tick_size.description: Minimum price increment. A decimal string, never a JSON number: a YAML/JSON float loses exactness on values like 0.1, and this is the value every price on the product's grid is a multiple of.

lot_size.description: Minimum tradable quantity increment. An integer needs no decimal-string treatment: it round-trips exactly in JSON/YAML.

multiplier.description: Contract multiplier (notional per point). Decimal string for the same reason as tick_size.

currency.description: ISO-4217-shaped currency code. Structural only: this schema does not maintain a currency registry.

timezone.description: IANA time zone key for the product's session. Checked against the installed tz database at load time (python/futures/instruments.py); this schema only enforces the shape.

session_template.description: Opaque reference to a session template. Trading-session calendars are AEGIS-013 (M2 slice 3) and do not exist yet; this field is a name, not a definition.
